event.description: David Mamet’s Oleanna is an uncomfortably relevant play exploring gender, authority, power, and education through a series of increasingly fraught conversations between a university professor and his student. Written in 1992 in response to the Anita Hill–Clarence Thomas hearings, the play examines what happens when assumptions, personal biases, and failures of communication turn differences into divisions. The production invites audiences to reflect on their own perspectives and continue the conversation with openness and respect. Join us on Thursday, Oct. 1, from 5–6:30 p.m. for a talkback and reception following that day’s 1 p.m. performance. Colorado College President Manya Whitaker will moderate the conversation. Refreshments and light hors d’oeuvres will be served. Talkback attendees may also receive a complimentary ticket to that evening’s performance of Come From Away, capacity permitting. The talkback and reception are free and open to the public. RSVPs are strongly encouraged. RSVP for the talkback get oleanna tickets

event.description: In 2015, a James Bond movie introduced millions to a spectacularly staged Día de los Muertos parade in Mexico City. Two years later, the Pixar movie Coco depicted some of the rituals associated with the Day of the Dead. But did you know that the Mexico City parade didn’t exist until the filmmakers created it? Or that Disney, in anticipation of Coco’s release, filed an application to trademark the phrase “Día de los Muertos” to sell merchandise? What does the actual observance look like, and has it always looked that way? Through a series of images, this lecture travels across Mexico to uncover the many regional traditions behind one of the world’s most recognizable commemorations. Peel back the Hollywood imagery to explore a family of living practices shaped by Indigenous ritual, Spanish Catholicism, and sometimes, even the movies. This lecture coincides with the FAC annual community event Día de Muertos, on November 1 and 2. Themed Cocktail: Muertos Margarita Lecturer: José Antonio Arellano, Associate Professor of English, United States Air Force Academy Tickets: $26 ($20 for FAC Members), includes your first drink Get TICKETS About Libation Lectures Libation Lectures is lecture series offering an educational twist to the traditional happy hour. Each lecture explores an aspect of the amazing art and artists from various FAC exhibitions and theatre shows, served up with a themed drink to help you really dive deep into the topic! event.title: Member Moments Backstage Tour: Costumes of White Christmas
event.venue_json: {"id":8439,"global_id":"fac.coloradocollege.edu?id=8439","venue":"Fine Arts Center","address":"30 W. Dale St.","city":"Colorado Springs","country":"United States","state":"CO","zip":"80903","phone":"(719) 634-5581","url":"https://fac.coloradocollege.edu/venue/fine-arts-center/","show_map":true,"show_map_link":true}
event.description: Members: Join our Associate Costume Designer for an inside look at the wardrobe magic behind White Christmas. From the military uniforms to the cozy Vermont knitwear and the red velvet dresses, every costume is created to survive up to seven shows a week of dancing, quick changes, and snow. You’ll get a close-up look at the fabrics, silhouettes, and period details that bring 1954 to life, hear how the design team balances vintage style with modern stagecraft, and learn what really goes into a lightning-fast costume change in the wings. It’s a rare chance to see the craftsmanship that usually stays hidden behind the curtain. RSVP required, space is limited. RSVP This is a members-only event. Not a member? Join today!

event.description: Join this first-of-its-kind mini-workshop and get creatively handsy with a selection of the Fine Arts Center’s Van Briggle pottery molds. Using portions of different molds, each student will create a small, unique clay sculpture, completely textured in authentic Van Briggle surfaces. No clay experience required, all skill levels welcome. Supplies will be provided. This series of workshops designed exclusively for our members to experience all the Fine Arts Center has to offer! Member Moments art classes allow our members to get a taste of various art media before diving into a full art class at Bemis School of Art. event.title: Member Moments: Get Muddy with Intro to Wheel Throwing
event.venue_json: {"id":14403,"global_id":"fac.coloradocollege.edu?id=14403","venue":"Bemis School of Art","address":"818 Pelham Pl","city":"Colorado Springs","country":"United States","state":"CO","zip":"80903","phone":"(719) 475-2444","url":"https://fac.coloradocollege.edu/venue/bemis-school-of-art/","geo_lat":38.84621,"geo_lng":-104.8265376,"show_map":true,"show_map_link":true}
event.description: Ready to spin some clay? Learn the basics of wheel throwing in this hands-on class where you’ll prep, center, and shape your own creations with expert guidance. It’s messy, meditative, and a whole lot of fun, perfect for curious beginners! Supplies will be provided. This series of workshops is designed exclusively for our members to experience all the Fine Arts Center has to offer! Member Moments art classes allow our members to get a taste of various art media before diving into a full art class at Bemis School of Art. Whether you’re a beginner or have some experience, we invite you to discover new skills, express your creativity, and connect with fellow art enthusiasts. Registration opens February 16, 2027 This is a members-only event. Not a member? Join today!
